Harbor is a framework from the creators of Terminal-Bench for evaluating and optimizing agents and language models. You can use Harbor to:

- Evaluate arbitrary agents like Claude Code, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and more.
- Build and share your own benchmarks and environments.
- Conduct experiments in thousands of environments in parallel through providers like Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel, Novita Sandbox, and Tensorlake.
- Generate rollouts for RL optimization.

Check out the Harbor Cookbook for end-to-end examples and guides.

## Installation

Permalink: Installation

```
uv tool install harbor
```

or

```
pip install harbor
```

## Example: Running Terminal-Bench-2.0

Permalink: Example: Running Terminal-Bench-2.0

Harbor is the official harness for Terminal-Bench-2.0:

```
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<YOUR-KEY>
harbor run --dataset terminal-bench@2.0 \
   --agent claude-code \
   --model anthropic/claude-opus-4-1 \
   --n-concurrent 4
```

This will launch the benchmark locally using Docker. To run it on a cloud provider (like Daytona) pass the `--env` flag as below:

```
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<YOUR-KEY>
export DAYTONA_API_KEY=<YOUR-KEY>
harbor run --dataset terminal-bench@2.0 \
   --agent claude-code \
   --model anthropic/claude-opus-4-1 \
   --n-concurrent 100 \
   --env daytona
```

To see all supported agents, and other options run:

```
harbor run --help
```

To explore all supported third party benchmarks (like SWE-Bench and Aider Polyglot) run:

```
harbor datasets list
```

To evaluate an agent and model one of these datasets, you can use the following command:

```
harbor run -d "<dataset@version>" -m "<model>" -a "<agent>"
```

## Citation

Permalink: Citation

If you use **Harbor** in academic work, please cite it using the “Cite this repository” button on GitHub or the following BibTeX entry:

```
@software{Harbor_Framework,
author = {{Harbor Framework Team}},
title = {{Harbor: A framework for evaluating and optimizing agents and models in container environments}},
year = {2026},
version = {v0.16.1},
doi = {10.5281/zenodo.20953922},
url = {https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20953922}
}
```

The DOI above is the **concept DOI**, which always resolves to the latest release and aggregates citations across all versions. To cite a specific version instead, use that version's DOI from the Zenodo record.

12	# APIs actually accept: Gemini audio understanding (wav, mp3, aiff, aac, ogg,
13	# flac), OpenAI transcription (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm),

16	AudioMediaType = Literal[
17	    "audio/wav",
18	    "audio/mpeg",
19	    "audio/mp4",
20	    "audio/aac",
21	    "audio/ogg",
22	    "audio/flac",

28	# way in so consumers only ever see one spelling per format. `audio/mp3` is the
29	# important one: it is not a registered type, but the Gemini API documents and
30	# emits it, so a producer copying a provider response verbatim would otherwise
31	# fail validation.
32	_AUDIO_MEDIA_TYPE_ALIASES = {
33	    "audio/mp3": "audio/mpeg",
34	    "audio/mpga": "audio/mpeg",
35	    "audio/x-mpeg": "audio/mpeg",
36	    "audio/x-wav": "audio/wav",
37	    "audio/wave": "audio/wav",

67	    Added in ATIF-v1.8. Mirrors ``ImageSource`` so that consumers can treat any
68	    referenced media the same way, with one addition: ``duration_sec``. Duration
69	    is worth recording because several providers bill audio per second and
70	    dataset statistics need it, and unlike an image's dimensions it cannot be
71	    recovered without decoding the file.

95	    @field_validator("media_type", mode="before")
96	    @classmethod
97	    def normalize_media_type(cls, value: Any) -> Any:
98	        """Accept common non-registered spellings, storing the canonical one."""
99	        if isinstance(value, str):

101	            return _AUDIO_MEDIA_TYPE_ALIASES.get(normalized, normalized)
102	        return value

106	    """A single content part within a multimodal message.
107	
108	    Used when a message or observation contains mixed content types (text,
109	    images, or audio). For text-only content, a plain string can still be used
110	    instead of a ContentPart array.
111	    """

113	    type: Literal["text", "image", "audio"] = Field(
114	        default=...,

116	    )
117	    text: str | None = Field(
118	        default=None,

120	    )

131	    @model_validator(mode="after")
132	    def validate_content_type(self) -> "ContentPart":
133	        """Validate that the correct fields are present for each content type."""
134	        if self.type == "text":
135	            if self.text is None:
136	                raise ValueError("'text' field is required when type='text'")
137	            if self.source is not None:
138	                raise ValueError("'source' field is not allowed when type='text'")
139	            return self
140	
141	        # Media parts: a source is required, text is not allowed, and the source
142	        # must be of the kind the `type` declares. Without the last check a
143	        # `source` union would happily accept an ImageSource under
144	        # type='audio' (and vice versa), silently mislabelling the content.
145	        if self.source is None:

147	        if self.text is not None:
148	            raise ValueError(f"'text' field is not allowed when type='{self.type}'")
149	
150	        expected = ImageSource if self.type == "image" else AudioSource
151	        if not isinstance(self.source, expected):
152	            raise ValueError(
153	                f"type='{self.type}' requires a {expected.__name__}, but the "
154	                f"source's media_type is {self.source.media_type!r}"
155	            )

429	                            for reward_value, entries in reward_map.items():
430	                                if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:

578	            system message
579

583	    conv: dict[str, Any] = {

585	        "agent": run_metadata["agent_name"],
586	        "model": run_metadata["model_name"],
587	        "model_provider": run_metadata["model_provider"],
588	        "date": run_metadata["start_time"],

598	
599	    # Track agent steps to know when to add observations

615	            # Add tool definitions to the first system message if available

618	                embed_tools_in_conversation
619	                and not tool_definitions_added
620	                and run_metadata.get("tool_definitions")

638	                {

643	        elif source == "agent":
644	            # Agent messages become assistant role

646	            content_parts = []
647	
648	            # Prepend reasoning_content wrapped in <think></think> tags if present
649	            reasoning_content = step.get("reasoning_content")
650	            if reasoning_content:
651	                content_parts.append(f"<think>{reasoning_content}</think>")
652	
653	            # Add the main message content
654	            if message:
655	                # Fix orphaned </think> tags: when the generation prompt includes
656	                # <think> but vLLM only returns generated tokens, the opening tag
657	                # is missing.  Detect this pattern and prepend <think> to restore
658	                # proper formatting.

670	                        "arguments": tool_call.get("arguments", {}),
671	                    }
672	                    tool_call_json = json.dumps(tool_call_obj, ensure_ascii=False)
673	                    content_parts.append(f"<tool_call>\n{tool_call_json}\n</tool_call>")
674	
675	            assistant_content = "\n".join(content_parts) if content_parts else ""
676	
677	            conv["conversations"].append(

679	                    "role": "assistant",
680	                    "content": assistant_content,
681	                }
682	            )

684	            # Add observation as user message, UNLESS this is the last agent step in the episode
685	            # (the last agent step's observation belongs to the next episode)
686	            is_last_agent_step = i == agent_steps[-1]
687	            if not is_last_agent_step:

690	                    results = observation.get("results", [])

163	    role_map = {"user": "human", "assistant": "gpt", "system": "system"}
164	    out = []
165	    for m in messages:
166	        role = m.get("role")
167	        content = normalize_message_content(m.get("content"))
168	        if role not in role_map:
169	            continue
170	        out.append({"from": role_map[role], "value": content})
171	    return out

217	def _normalize_run_metadata(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
218	    """Extract trace metadata from a trial result blob with backward compatibility.
219	
220	    Older Harbor runs may omit fields such as ``config`` or ``agent_info``. Rather
221	    than raising a KeyError, we provide sensible defaults so callers can still export.
222	    """
223	
224	    def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
225	        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}
226	
227	    config = _as_dict(raw.get("config"))
228	
229	    agent_cfg: dict[str, Any] = {}
230	    if isinstance(config.get("agent"), dict):
231	        agent_cfg = config["agent"]
232	    elif isinstance(config.get("agents"), list) and config["agents"]:
233	        first_agent = config["agents"][0]
234	        if isinstance(first_agent, dict):
235	            agent_cfg = first_agent
236	
237	    agent_info = _as_dict(raw.get("agent_info"))
238	    model_info = _as_dict(agent_info.get("model_info"))
239	
240	    agent_name = (
241	        agent_cfg.get("name")
242	        or agent_info.get("name")
243	        or config.get("agent_name")
244	        or raw.get("agent_name")
245	        or "unknown-agent"
246	    )
247	
248	    if agent_name == "unknown-agent":
249	        raise ValueError("Unable to determine agent name from result.json metadata")
250	
251	    model_name = (
252	        model_info.get("name")
253	        or agent_cfg.get("model_name")
254	        or agent_info.get("model_name")
255	        or config.get("engine")
256	        or "unknown-model"
257	    )
258	
259	    model_provider = (
260	        model_info.get("provider")
261	        or agent_cfg.get("provider")
262	        or agent_info.get("provider")
263	        or config.get("engine")
264	        or "unknown-provider"
265	    )
266	
267	    run_id = (
268	        config.get("job_id")
269	        or config.get("job_name")
270	        or raw.get("job_id")
271	        or raw.get("run_id")
272	        or raw.get("trial_name")
273	        or "unknown-run"
274	    )
275	
276	    start_time = raw.get("started_at") or raw.get("startedAt") or ""
277	
278	    # Extract task_name and trial_name with fallbacks
279	    task_name = raw.get("task_name") or config.get("task_name") or "unknown-task"
280	    trial_name = raw.get("trial_name") or config.get("trial_name") or "unknown-trial"
281	
282	    return {
283	        "agent_name": agent_name,
284	        "model_name": model_name,
285	        "model_provider": model_provider,
286	        "start_time": start_time,
287	        "run_id": run_id,
288	        "task_name": task_name,
289	        "trial_name": trial_name,
290	        "raw_metadata": raw,
291	    }

294	def _find_result_json(trial_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
295	    """Search upwards from a trial directory for result.json."""
296	    cur = trial_dir
297	    for _ in range(4):
298	        candidate = cur / "result.json"
299	        if candidate.exists():
300	            return candidate
301	        if cur.parent == cur:
302	            break
303	        cur = cur.parent
304	    return None

316	def _load_job_result_data(trial_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
317	    """Search upwards for the job-level result.json that contains aggregate stats.
318	
319	    Start at trial_dir.parent so the trial's own result.json (which may itself
320	    contain a "stats" key) is never matched as job-level.
321	    """
322	    cur = trial_dir.parent
323	    for _ in range(6):
324	        candidate = cur / "result.json"
325	        if candidate.exists():
326	            data = _read_json_cached(candidate)
327	            if isinstance(data, dict) and "stats" in data:
328	                return data
329	        if cur.parent == cur:
330	            break
331	        cur = cur.parent
332	    return None

335	def _extract_instruction(trial_dir: Path, agent_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
336	    """Return the initial instruction text extracted from the main trajectory."""
337	    agent_dir = trial_dir / "agent"
338	    if not agent_dir.exists():
339	        return None
340	
341	    # Prefer the primary trajectory.json; fall back to the earliest continuation.
342	    trajectory_paths = sorted(
343	        path
344	        for path in agent_dir.glob("trajectory*.json")
345	        if ".summarization" not in path.name  # skip subagent summaries
346	    )
347	    if not trajectory_paths:
348	        return None
349	
350	    try:
351	        trajectory = _read_json_cached(trajectory_paths[0])
352	    except OSError:
353	        return None
354	
355	    steps = trajectory.get("steps")
356	    if not isinstance(steps, list):
357	        return None
358	
359	    for step in steps:
360	        if not isinstance(step, dict):
361	            continue
362	        message = step.get("message")
363	        if isinstance(message, str) and message.strip():
364	            return message.strip()
365	
366	    return None

369	def _read_verifier_output(trial_dir: Path) -> Optional[str]:
370	    """Read verifier stdout/stderr files and concatenate them when present."""
371	    verifier_dir = trial_dir / "verifier"
372	    stdout_path = verifier_dir / "test-stdout.txt"
373	    stderr_path = verifier_dir / "test-stderr.txt"
374	
375	    parts: list[str] = []
376	    for path in (stdout_path, stderr_path):
377	        if not path.exists():
378	            continue
379	        try:
380	            parts.append(path.read_text(errors="replace"))
381	        except OSError:
382	            continue
383	
384	    if not parts:
385	        return None
386	
387	    return "".join(parts)

398	def _extract_trial_result_value(trial_dir: Path, trial_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
399	    """Return exception type or reward bucket for a given trial.
400	
401	    Checks two sources in order:
402	    1. Job-level result.json (aggregate stats from eval orchestrator)
403	    2. Per-trial result.json (individual trial result with verifier_result)
404	
405	    The job-level file exists for eval/datagen jobs but NOT for RL training jobs,
406	    where each trial has its own result.json with verifier_result.rewards.
407	    """
408	    # 1. Try job-level aggregate stats (eval orchestrator)
409	    result_data = _load_job_result_data(trial_dir)
410	    if result_data:
411	        stats = result_data.get("stats")
412	        if isinstance(stats, dict):
413	            evals = stats.get("evals")
414	            if isinstance(evals, dict):
415	                for eval_data in evals.values():
416	                    if not isinstance(eval_data, dict):
417	                        continue
418	
419	                    exception_stats = eval_data.get("exception_stats")
420	                    if isinstance(exception_stats, dict):
421	                        for exc_name, entries in exception_stats.items():
422	                            if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
423	                                return exc_name
424	
425	                    reward_stats = eval_data.get("reward_stats")
426	                    if isinstance(reward_stats, dict):
427	                        reward_map = reward_stats.get("reward")
428	                        if isinstance(reward_map, dict):
429	                            for reward_value, entries in reward_map.items():
430	                                if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
431	                                    result_value = _coerce_reward_value(reward_value)
432	                                    return (
433	                                        result_value
434	                                        if isinstance(result_value, str)
435	                                        else str(result_value)
436	                                    )
437	
438	    # 2. Fallback: read per-trial result.json directly (RL training jobs)
439	    trial_data = _load_result_data(trial_dir)
440	    if isinstance(trial_data, dict):
441	        # Check for exception first
442	        exc_info = trial_data.get("exception_info")
443	        if isinstance(exc_info, dict):
444	            exc_type = exc_info.get("exception_type")
445	            if exc_type:
446	                return str(exc_type)
447	
448	        # Extract reward from verifier_result
449	        vr = trial_data.get("verifier_result")
450	        if isinstance(vr, dict):
451	            rewards = vr.get("rewards")
452	            if isinstance(rewards, dict):
453	                reward = rewards.get("reward")
454	                if reward is not None:
455	                    return str(_coerce_reward_value(reward))
456	
457	    return None
458

464	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No result.json found for trial {trial_dir}")
465	    return _normalize_run_metadata(data)

468	def extract_conversations_from_trajectory(
469	    trajectory_file: Path,
470	    run_metadata: dict[str, Any],
471	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
472	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
473	    """Extract all episode conversations from a trajectory file.
474	
475	    Reads the trajectory once and generates one conversation per episode.
476	    Episodes are determined by agent steps - each agent step marks the end of an episode.
477	
478	    Note: Steps marked with is_copied_context=True are excluded from training data
479	    as they represent interactions already present in previous trajectories.
480	
481	    Args:
482	        trajectory_file: Path to the trajectory.json file
483	        run_metadata: Run metadata dictionary
484	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
485	            system message as ``<tools>...</tools>`` tags (default: True)
486	
487	    Returns:
488	        List of conversation dicts, one per episode
489	
490	    Raises:
491	        MultimodalExportError: If the trajectory contains multimodal content (images).
492	            Text-only export does not support multimodal trajectories to prevent
493	            silent data loss.
494	    """
495	    try:
496	        trajectory_data = json.loads(trajectory_file.read_text())
497	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
498	        print(f"[traces] Skipping trajectory {trajectory_file}: invalid JSON ({e})")
499	        return []
500	
501	    # FAIL FAST: Check for multimodal content
502	    if _trajectory_has_multimodal_content(trajectory_data):
503	        raise MultimodalExportError(
504	            f"Trajectory '{trajectory_file}' contains multimodal content (images). "
505	            f"Text-only export is not supported for multimodal trajectories. "
506	            f"Use a multimodal training pipeline or filter out multimodal trajectories."
507	        )
508	
509	    steps = trajectory_data.get("steps", [])
510	
511	    # Use agent name from trajectory if available (for subagent trajectories),
512	    # otherwise fall back to run_metadata agent name
513	    agent_info = trajectory_data.get("agent", {})
514	    trajectory_agent_name = agent_info.get("name") or run_metadata["agent_name"]
515	    trajectory_model_name = agent_info.get("model_name") or run_metadata["model_name"]
516	
517	    # Extract tool definitions if available
518	    tool_definitions = agent_info.get("tool_definitions")
519	
520	    # Create a modified run_metadata for this specific trajectory
521	    trajectory_run_metadata = {
522	        **run_metadata,
523	        "agent_name": trajectory_agent_name,
524	        "model_name": trajectory_model_name,
525	        "tool_definitions": tool_definitions,
526	    }
527	
528	    # Find all agent steps (each marks the end of an episode)
529	    # Exclude steps marked as copied context
530	    agent_step_indices = []
531	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
532	        if step.get("source") == "agent":
533	            # Skip steps marked as copied context (e.g., handoff steps)
534	            if step.get("is_copied_context"):
535	                continue
536	            agent_step_indices.append(i)
537	
538	    if not agent_step_indices:
539	        return []
540	
541	    # Generate one conversation per episode
542	    conversations = []
543	    for episode_num, agent_step_idx in enumerate(agent_step_indices):
544	        conv = _extract_single_episode_conversation(
545	            steps[
546	                : agent_step_idx + 1
547	            ],  # Include all steps up to and including this agent step
548	            episode_num,
549	            trajectory_run_metadata,
550	            embed_tools_in_conversation,
551	        )
552	        if conv and conv.get("conversations"):
553	            conversations.append(conv)
554	
555	    return conversations
556

558	def _extract_single_episode_conversation(
559	    steps: list[dict[str, Any]],
560	    episode_num: int,
561	    run_metadata: dict[str, Any],
562	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
563	) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
564	    """Extract conversation for a single episode from trajectory steps.
565	
566	    Episodes end with the assistant's response. Observations from each agent step
567	    are added as user messages before the next agent turn, except for the last
568	    agent step in the episode (whose observation belongs to the next episode).
569	
570	    Steps marked with is_copied_context=True are included in the conversation
571	    but don't trigger new episode boundaries.
572	
573	    Args:
574	        steps: List of trajectory steps for this episode
575	        episode_num: Episode number (0-indexed)
576	        run_metadata: Run metadata dictionary
577	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
578	            system message
579	
580	    Returns:
581	        Conversation dict for this episode
582	    """
583	    conv: dict[str, Any] = {
584	        "conversations": [],
585	        "agent": run_metadata["agent_name"],
586	        "model": run_metadata["model_name"],
587	        "model_provider": run_metadata["model_provider"],
588	        "date": run_metadata["start_time"],
589	        "task": None,  # to be filled by caller
590	        "episode": f"episode-{episode_num}",
591	        "run_id": run_metadata["run_id"],
592	        "trial_name": None,  # to be filled by caller
593	    }
594	
595	    # Add tool definitions if available
596	    if run_metadata.get("tool_definitions"):
597	        conv["tool_definitions"] = run_metadata["tool_definitions"]
598	
599	    # Track agent steps to know when to add observations
600	    # Note: We use ALL steps (including copied context) for building the conversation
601	    agent_steps = []
602	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
603	        if step.get("source") == "agent":
604	            agent_steps.append(i)
605	
606	    # Track if we've added tool definitions yet (should be added to first system message)
607	    tool_definitions_added = False
608	
609	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
610	        source = step.get("source")
611	        message = step.get("message", "")
612	
613	        if source == "system":
614	            # System messages become user role (task instruction from user)
615	            # Add tool definitions to the first system message if available
616	            content = message
617	            if (
618	                embed_tools_in_conversation
619	                and not tool_definitions_added
620	                and run_metadata.get("tool_definitions")
621	            ):
622	                # Format tool definitions as <tools>...</tools>
623	                tools_json = json.dumps(
624	                    run_metadata["tool_definitions"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2
625	                )
626	                content = f"<tools>\n{tools_json}\n</tools>\n\n{message}"
627	                tool_definitions_added = True
628	
629	            conv["conversations"].append(
630	                {
631	                    "role": "user",
632	                    "content": content,
633	                }
634	            )
635	        elif source == "user":
636	            # User messages remain user role
637	            conv["conversations"].append(
638	                {
639	                    "role": "user",
640	                    "content": message,
641	                }
642	            )
643	        elif source == "agent":
644	            # Agent messages become assistant role
645	            # Format: <think>reasoning_content</think> + message + tool_calls JSON
646	            content_parts = []
647	
648	            # Prepend reasoning_content wrapped in <think></think> tags if present
649	            reasoning_content = step.get("reasoning_content")
650	            if reasoning_content:
651	                content_parts.append(f"<think>{reasoning_content}</think>")
652	
653	            # Add the main message content
654	            if message:
655	                # Fix orphaned </think> tags: when the generation prompt includes
656	                # <think> but vLLM only returns generated tokens, the opening tag
657	                # is missing.  Detect this pattern and prepend <think> to restore
658	                # proper formatting.
659	                if "</think>" in message and "<think>" not in message:
660	                    message = "<think>" + message
661	                content_parts.append(message)
662	
663	            # Append tool_calls in the specified format if present
664	            # Format: <tool_call>\n{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}\n</tool_call>
665	            tool_calls = step.get("tool_calls")
666	            if tool_calls:
667	                for tool_call in tool_calls:
668	                    tool_call_obj = {
669	                        "name": tool_call.get("function_name"),
670	                        "arguments": tool_call.get("arguments", {}),
671	                    }
672	                    tool_call_json = json.dumps(tool_call_obj, ensure_ascii=False)
673	                    content_parts.append(f"<tool_call>\n{tool_call_json}\n</tool_call>")
674	
675	            assistant_content = "\n".join(content_parts) if content_parts else ""
676	
677	            conv["conversations"].append(
678	                {
679	                    "role": "assistant",
680	                    "content": assistant_content,
681	                }
682	            )
683	
684	            # Add observation as user message, UNLESS this is the last agent step in the episode
685	            # (the last agent step's observation belongs to the next episode)
686	            is_last_agent_step = i == agent_steps[-1]
687	            if not is_last_agent_step:
688	                observation = step.get("observation")
689	                if observation and isinstance(observation, dict):
690	                    results = observation.get("results", [])
691	                    if results:
692	                        # Combine all observation results into a single user message
693	                        observation_contents = []
694	                        for result in results:
695	                            if isinstance(result, dict) and "content" in result:
696	                                # Use normalize_message_content to handle both string
697	                                # and list content formats
698	                                observation_contents.append(
699	                                    normalize_message_content(result["content"])
700	                                )
701	
702	                        if observation_contents:
703	                            observation_text = "\n".join(observation_contents)
704	                            conv["conversations"].append(
705	                                {
706	                                    "role": "user",
707	                                    "content": observation_text,
708	                                }
709	                            )
710	
711	    return conv

717	    """Extract subagent trajectory references from a trajectory file.
718	
719	    Returns:

721	    """

724	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
725	        return []
726	
727	    refs = []
728	    steps = trajectory_data.get("steps", [])
729

731	        observation = step.get("observation", {})
732	        if not observation:
733	            continue
734	
735	        results = observation.get("results", [])
736	        for result in results:
737	            if not isinstance(result, dict):
738	                continue
739

744	                    refs.append(trajectory_path)
745	
746	    return refs

749	def collect_conversations_from_trial(
750	    trial_dir: Path,
751	    run_meta: dict[str, Any],
752	    episodes: str = "all",
753	    verbose: bool = False,
754	    include_instruction: bool = False,
755	    include_verifier_output: bool = False,
756	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
757	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
758	    """Collect conversation traces from a trial.
759	
760	    Supports:
761	    - Single trajectory files
762	    - Continuation trajectories (when linear_history mode is enabled)
763	
764	    Note: This function only collects traces from the main agent trajectory
765	    and its continuations. For subagent traces, use collect_subagent_traces().
766	
767	    Args:
768	        trial_dir: Path to trial directory
769	        run_meta: Run metadata dictionary
770	        episodes: "all" to collect all episodes, or "last" to collect only the last completed episode
771	        verbose: Whether to print verbose output
772	        include_instruction: Include instruction text metadata when available
773	        include_verifier_output: Include verifier stdout/stderr metadata when available
774	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
775	            system message (default: True)
776	
777	    Returns:
778	        List of conversation dicts
779	    """
780	    task_name = run_meta["task_name"]
781	    trial_name = run_meta["trial_name"]
782	    result_value = _extract_trial_result_value(trial_dir, trial_name)
783	    instruction_text = (
784	        _extract_instruction(trial_dir, run_meta["agent_name"])
785	        if include_instruction
786	        else None
787	    )
788	    verifier_output = (
789	        _read_verifier_output(trial_dir) if include_verifier_output else None
790	    )
791	
792	    agent_dir = trial_dir / "agent"
793	
794	    # Build trajectory processing order
795	    # Only include main trajectory and continuation trajectories
796	    # Subagent trajectories should be exported separately
797	    trajectory_order = []
798	
799	    # Start with main trajectory
800	    main_traj = agent_dir / "trajectory.json"
801	    if not main_traj.exists():
802	        if verbose:
803	            print(f"[traces] Trial {trial_dir.name}: no trajectory.json found")

117	def normalize_message_content(content: Any) -> str:
118	    """Return a best-effort textual content from various message encodings.
119	
120	    Handles:
121	    - str
122	    - list[dict] with {'text': '...'} entries (first element preferred)
123	    - arbitrary serializable objects (json-dumped)
124	    """
125	    if content is None:
126	        return ""
127	    if isinstance(content, str):
128	        return content
129	    if isinstance(content, list) and content:
130	        first = content[0]
131	        if isinstance(first, dict) and "text" in first:
132	            val = first.get("text")
133	            return val if isinstance(val, str) else json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False)
134	    try:
135	        return json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False)
136	    except TypeError:
137	        return str(content)

398	def _extract_trial_result_value(trial_dir: Path, trial_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
399	    """Return exception type or reward bucket for a given trial.
400	
401	    Checks two sources in order:
402	    1. Job-level result.json (aggregate stats from eval orchestrator)
403	    2. Per-trial result.json (individual trial result with verifier_result)
404	
405	    The job-level file exists for eval/datagen jobs but NOT for RL training jobs,
406	    where each trial has its own result.json with verifier_result.rewards.
407	    """
408	    # 1. Try job-level aggregate stats (eval orchestrator)
409	    result_data = _load_job_result_data(trial_dir)
410	    if result_data:
411	        stats = result_data.get("stats")
412	        if isinstance(stats, dict):
413	            evals = stats.get("evals")
414	            if isinstance(evals, dict):
415	                for eval_data in evals.values():
416	                    if not isinstance(eval_data, dict):
417	                        continue
418	
419	                    exception_stats = eval_data.get("exception_stats")
420	                    if isinstance(exception_stats, dict):
421	                        for exc_name, entries in exception_stats.items():
422	                            if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
423	                                return exc_name
424	
425	                    reward_stats = eval_data.get("reward_stats")
426	                    if isinstance(reward_stats, dict):
427	                        reward_map = reward_stats.get("reward")
428	                        if isinstance(reward_map, dict):
429	                            for reward_value, entries in reward_map.items():
430	                                if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
431	                                    result_value = _coerce_reward_value(reward_value)
432	                                    return (
433	                                        result_value
434	                                        if isinstance(result_value, str)
435	                                        else str(result_value)
436	                                    )
437	
438	    # 2. Fallback: read per-trial result.json directly (RL training jobs)
439	    trial_data = _load_result_data(trial_dir)
440	    if isinstance(trial_data, dict):
441	        # Check for exception first
442	        exc_info = trial_data.get("exception_info")
443	        if isinstance(exc_info, dict):
444	            exc_type = exc_info.get("exception_type")
445	            if exc_type:
446	                return str(exc_type)
447	
448	        # Extract reward from verifier_result
449	        vr = trial_data.get("verifier_result")
450	        if isinstance(vr, dict):
451	            rewards = vr.get("rewards")

63	    """Read JSON from path with caching and graceful error handling."""
64	    resolved = path.resolve()
65	    if resolved in _RESULT_JSON_CACHE:
66	        return _RESULT_JSON_CACHE[resolved]
67	    try:
68	        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
69	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
70	        data = None
71	    _RESULT_JSON_CACHE[resolved] = data
72	    return data

117	def normalize_message_content(content: Any) -> str:
118	    """Return a best-effort textual content from various message encodings.
119	
120	    Handles:
121	    - str
122	    - list[dict] with {'text': '...'} entries (first element preferred)
123	    - arbitrary serializable objects (json-dumped)
124	    """
125	    if content is None:
126	        return ""
127	    if isinstance(content, str):
128	        return content
129	    if isinstance(content, list) and content:
130	        first = content[0]
131	        if isinstance(first, dict) and "text" in first:
132	            val = first.get("text")
133	            return val if isinstance(val, str) else json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False)
134	    try:
135	        return json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False)
136	    except TypeError:
137	        return str(content)

140	def _deep_find_reasoning_content(payload: Any) -> Any:
141	    """Recursively search a payload for a reasoning_content field."""
142	    if isinstance(payload, dict):
143	        if payload.get("reasoning_content") is not None:
144	            return payload["reasoning_content"]
145	        for value in payload.values():
146	            found = _deep_find_reasoning_content(value)
147	            if found is not None:
148	                return found
149	    elif isinstance(payload, list):
150	        for item in payload:
151	            found = _deep_find_reasoning_content(item)
152	            if found is not None:
153	                return found
154	    return None

162	def openai_to_sharegpt(messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
163	    role_map = {"user": "human", "assistant": "gpt", "system": "system"}
164	    out = []
165	    for m in messages:
166	        role = m.get("role")
167	        content = normalize_message_content(m.get("content"))
168	        if role not in role_map:
169	            continue
170	        out.append({"from": role_map[role], "value": content})
171	    return out

195	def iter_trial_dirs(root: Path, recursive: bool = True) -> Iterator[Path]:
196	    """Yield directories that look like trial outputs.
197	
198	    If root itself is a trial dir, yield it once. Otherwise, recursively search
199	    for subdirectories containing an 'agent' subdirectory.
200	    """
201	    root = Path(root)

217	def _normalize_run_metadata(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
218	    """Extract trace metadata from a trial result blob with backward compatibility.
219	
220	    Older Harbor runs may omit fields such as ``config`` or ``agent_info``. Rather
221	    than raising a KeyError, we provide sensible defaults so callers can still export.
222	    """
223	
224	    def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
225	        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}
226	
227	    config = _as_dict(raw.get("config"))
228	
229	    agent_cfg: dict[str, Any] = {}
230	    if isinstance(config.get("agent"), dict):
231	        agent_cfg = config["agent"]
232	    elif isinstance(config.get("agents"), list) and config["agents"]:
233	        first_agent = config["agents"][0]
234	        if isinstance(first_agent, dict):
235	            agent_cfg = first_agent
236	
237	    agent_info = _as_dict(raw.get("agent_info"))
238	    model_info = _as_dict(agent_info.get("model_info"))
239	
240	    agent_name = (
241	        agent_cfg.get("name")
242	        or agent_info.get("name")
243	        or config.get("agent_name")
244	        or raw.get("agent_name")
245	        or "unknown-agent"
246	    )
247	
248	    if agent_name == "unknown-agent":
249	        raise ValueError("Unable to determine agent name from result.json metadata")
250	
251	    model_name = (
252	        model_info.get("name")
253	        or agent_cfg.get("model_name")
254	        or agent_info.get("model_name")
255	        or config.get("engine")
256	        or "unknown-model"
257	    )
258	
259	    model_provider = (
260	        model_info.get("provider")
261	        or agent_cfg.get("provider")
262	        or agent_info.get("provider")
263	        or config.get("engine")
264	        or "unknown-provider"
265	    )
266	
267	    run_id = (
268	        config.get("job_id")
269	        or config.get("job_name")
270	        or raw.get("job_id")
271	        or raw.get("run_id")
272	        or raw.get("trial_name")
273	        or "unknown-run"
274	    )
275	
276	    start_time = raw.get("started_at") or raw.get("startedAt") or ""
277	
278	    # Extract task_name and trial_name with fallbacks
279	    task_name = raw.get("task_name") or config.get("task_name") or "unknown-task"
280	    trial_name = raw.get("trial_name") or config.get("trial_name") or "unknown-trial"
281	
282	    return {
283	        "agent_name": agent_name,
284	        "model_name": model_name,
285	        "model_provider": model_provider,
286	        "start_time": start_time,
287	        "run_id": run_id,
288	        "task_name": task_name,
289	        "trial_name": trial_name,
290	        "raw_metadata": raw,
291	    }

294	def _find_result_json(trial_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
295	    """Search upwards from a trial directory for result.json."""
296	    cur = trial_dir
297	    for _ in range(4):
298	        candidate = cur / "result.json"
299	        if candidate.exists():
300	            return candidate
301	        if cur.parent == cur:
302	            break
303	        cur = cur.parent
304	    return None

308	    """Load and cache the per-trial result.json (metadata) file."""
309	    result_path = _find_result_json(trial_dir)
310	    if result_path is None:
311	        return None
312	    data = _read_json_cached(result_path)
313	    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None

316	def _load_job_result_data(trial_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
317	    """Search upwards for the job-level result.json that contains aggregate stats.
318	
319	    Start at trial_dir.parent so the trial's own result.json (which may itself
320	    contain a "stats" key) is never matched as job-level.
321	    """
322	    cur = trial_dir.parent
323	    for _ in range(6):
324	        candidate = cur / "result.json"
325	        if candidate.exists():
326	            data = _read_json_cached(candidate)
327	            if isinstance(data, dict) and "stats" in data:
328	                return data
329	        if cur.parent == cur:
330	            break
331	        cur = cur.parent
332	    return None

335	def _extract_instruction(trial_dir: Path, agent_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
336	    """Return the initial instruction text extracted from the main trajectory."""
337	    agent_dir = trial_dir / "agent"
338	    if not agent_dir.exists():
339	        return None
340	
341	    # Prefer the primary trajectory.json; fall back to the earliest continuation.
342	    trajectory_paths = sorted(
343	        path
344	        for path in agent_dir.glob("trajectory*.json")
345	        if ".summarization" not in path.name  # skip subagent summaries
346	    )
347	    if not trajectory_paths:
348	        return None
349	
350	    try:
351	        trajectory = _read_json_cached(trajectory_paths[0])
352	    except OSError:
353	        return None
354	
355	    steps = trajectory.get("steps")
356	    if not isinstance(steps, list):
357	        return None
358	
359	    for step in steps:
360	        if not isinstance(step, dict):
361	            continue
362	        message = step.get("message")
363	        if isinstance(message, str) and message.strip():
364	            return message.strip()
365	
366	    return None

369	def _read_verifier_output(trial_dir: Path) -> Optional[str]:
370	    """Read verifier stdout/stderr files and concatenate them when present."""
371	    verifier_dir = trial_dir / "verifier"
372	    stdout_path = verifier_dir / "test-stdout.txt"
373	    stderr_path = verifier_dir / "test-stderr.txt"
374	
375	    parts: list[str] = []
376	    for path in (stdout_path, stderr_path):
377	        if not path.exists():
378	            continue
379	        try:
380	            parts.append(path.read_text(errors="replace"))
381	        except OSError:
382	            continue
383	
384	    if not parts:
385	        return None
386	
387	    return "".join(parts)

398	def _extract_trial_result_value(trial_dir: Path, trial_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
399	    """Return exception type or reward bucket for a given trial.
400	
401	    Checks two sources in order:
402	    1. Job-level result.json (aggregate stats from eval orchestrator)
403	    2. Per-trial result.json (individual trial result with verifier_result)
404	
405	    The job-level file exists for eval/datagen jobs but NOT for RL training jobs,
406	    where each trial has its own result.json with verifier_result.rewards.
407	    """
408	    # 1. Try job-level aggregate stats (eval orchestrator)
409	    result_data = _load_job_result_data(trial_dir)
410	    if result_data:
411	        stats = result_data.get("stats")
412	        if isinstance(stats, dict):
413	            evals = stats.get("evals")
414	            if isinstance(evals, dict):
415	                for eval_data in evals.values():
416	                    if not isinstance(eval_data, dict):
417	                        continue
418	
419	                    exception_stats = eval_data.get("exception_stats")
420	                    if isinstance(exception_stats, dict):
421	                        for exc_name, entries in exception_stats.items():
422	                            if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
423	                                return exc_name
424	
425	                    reward_stats = eval_data.get("reward_stats")
426	                    if isinstance(reward_stats, dict):
427	                        reward_map = reward_stats.get("reward")
428	                        if isinstance(reward_map, dict):
429	                            for reward_value, entries in reward_map.items():
430	                                if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
431	                                    result_value = _coerce_reward_value(reward_value)
432	                                    return (
433	                                        result_value
434	                                        if isinstance(result_value, str)
435	                                        else str(result_value)
436	                                    )
437	
438	    # 2. Fallback: read per-trial result.json directly (RL training jobs)
439	    trial_data = _load_result_data(trial_dir)
440	    if isinstance(trial_data, dict):
441	        # Check for exception first
442	        exc_info = trial_data.get("exception_info")
443	        if isinstance(exc_info, dict):
444	            exc_type = exc_info.get("exception_type")
445	            if exc_type:
446	                return str(exc_type)
447	
448	        # Extract reward from verifier_result
449	        vr = trial_data.get("verifier_result")
450	        if isinstance(vr, dict):
451	            rewards = vr.get("rewards")
452	            if isinstance(rewards, dict):
453	                reward = rewards.get("reward")
454	                if reward is not None:
455	                    return str(_coerce_reward_value(reward))
456	
457	    return None
458

462	    data = _load_result_data(trial_dir)
463	    if data is None:
464	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No result.json found for trial {trial_dir}")
465	    return _normalize_run_metadata(data)

468	def extract_conversations_from_trajectory(
469	    trajectory_file: Path,
470	    run_metadata: dict[str, Any],
471	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
472	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
473	    """Extract all episode conversations from a trajectory file.
474	
475	    Reads the trajectory once and generates one conversation per episode.
476	    Episodes are determined by agent steps - each agent step marks the end of an episode.
477	
478	    Note: Steps marked with is_copied_context=True are excluded from training data
479	    as they represent interactions already present in previous trajectories.
480	
481	    Args:
482	        trajectory_file: Path to the trajectory.json file
483	        run_metadata: Run metadata dictionary
484	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
485	            system message as ``<tools>...</tools>`` tags (default: True)
486	
487	    Returns:
488	        List of conversation dicts, one per episode
489	
490	    Raises:
491	        MultimodalExportError: If the trajectory contains multimodal content (images).
492	            Text-only export does not support multimodal trajectories to prevent
493	            silent data loss.
494	    """
495	    try:
496	        trajectory_data = json.loads(trajectory_file.read_text())
497	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
498	        print(f"[traces] Skipping trajectory {trajectory_file}: invalid JSON ({e})")
499	        return []
500	
501	    # FAIL FAST: Check for multimodal content
502	    if _trajectory_has_multimodal_content(trajectory_data):
503	        raise MultimodalExportError(
504	            f"Trajectory '{trajectory_file}' contains multimodal content (images). "
505	            f"Text-only export is not supported for multimodal trajectories. "
506	            f"Use a multimodal training pipeline or filter out multimodal trajectories."
507	        )
508	
509	    steps = trajectory_data.get("steps", [])
510	
511	    # Use agent name from trajectory if available (for subagent trajectories),
512	    # otherwise fall back to run_metadata agent name
513	    agent_info = trajectory_data.get("agent", {})
514	    trajectory_agent_name = agent_info.get("name") or run_metadata["agent_name"]
515	    trajectory_model_name = agent_info.get("model_name") or run_metadata["model_name"]
516	
517	    # Extract tool definitions if available
518	    tool_definitions = agent_info.get("tool_definitions")
519	
520	    # Create a modified run_metadata for this specific trajectory
521	    trajectory_run_metadata = {
522	        **run_metadata,
523	        "agent_name": trajectory_agent_name,
524	        "model_name": trajectory_model_name,
525	        "tool_definitions": tool_definitions,
526	    }
527	
528	    # Find all agent steps (each marks the end of an episode)
529	    # Exclude steps marked as copied context
530	    agent_step_indices = []
531	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
532	        if step.get("source") == "agent":
533	            # Skip steps marked as copied context (e.g., handoff steps)
534	            if step.get("is_copied_context"):
535	                continue
536	            agent_step_indices.append(i)
537	
538	    if not agent_step_indices:
539	        return []
540	
541	    # Generate one conversation per episode
542	    conversations = []
543	    for episode_num, agent_step_idx in enumerate(agent_step_indices):
544	        conv = _extract_single_episode_conversation(
545	            steps[
546	                : agent_step_idx + 1
547	            ],  # Include all steps up to and including this agent step
548	            episode_num,
549	            trajectory_run_metadata,
550	            embed_tools_in_conversation,
551	        )
552	        if conv and conv.get("conversations"):
553	            conversations.append(conv)
554	
555	    return conversations
556

558	def _extract_single_episode_conversation(
559	    steps: list[dict[str, Any]],
560	    episode_num: int,
561	    run_metadata: dict[str, Any],
562	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
563	) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
564	    """Extract conversation for a single episode from trajectory steps.
565	
566	    Episodes end with the assistant's response. Observations from each agent step
567	    are added as user messages before the next agent turn, except for the last
568	    agent step in the episode (whose observation belongs to the next episode).
569	
570	    Steps marked with is_copied_context=True are included in the conversation
571	    but don't trigger new episode boundaries.
572	
573	    Args:
574	        steps: List of trajectory steps for this episode
575	        episode_num: Episode number (0-indexed)
576	        run_metadata: Run metadata dictionary
577	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
578	            system message
579	
580	    Returns:
581	        Conversation dict for this episode
582	    """
583	    conv: dict[str, Any] = {
584	        "conversations": [],
585	        "agent": run_metadata["agent_name"],
586	        "model": run_metadata["model_name"],
587	        "model_provider": run_metadata["model_provider"],
588	        "date": run_metadata["start_time"],
589	        "task": None,  # to be filled by caller
590	        "episode": f"episode-{episode_num}",
591	        "run_id": run_metadata["run_id"],
592	        "trial_name": None,  # to be filled by caller
593	    }
594	
595	    # Add tool definitions if available
596	    if run_metadata.get("tool_definitions"):
597	        conv["tool_definitions"] = run_metadata["tool_definitions"]
598	
599	    # Track agent steps to know when to add observations
600	    # Note: We use ALL steps (including copied context) for building the conversation
601	    agent_steps = []
602	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
603	        if step.get("source") == "agent":
604	            agent_steps.append(i)
605	
606	    # Track if we've added tool definitions yet (should be added to first system message)
607	    tool_definitions_added = False
608	
609	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
610	        source = step.get("source")
611	        message = step.get("message", "")
612	
613	        if source == "system":
614	            # System messages become user role (task instruction from user)
615	            # Add tool definitions to the first system message if available
616	            content = message
617	            if (
618	                embed_tools_in_conversation
619	                and not tool_definitions_added
620	                and run_metadata.get("tool_definitions")
621	            ):
622	                # Format tool definitions as <tools>...</tools>
623	                tools_json = json.dumps(
624	                    run_metadata["tool_definitions"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2
625	                )
626	                content = f"<tools>\n{tools_json}\n</tools>\n\n{message}"
627	                tool_definitions_added = True
628	
629	            conv["conversations"].append(
630	                {
631	                    "role": "user",
632	                    "content": content,
633	                }
634	            )
635	        elif source == "user":
636	            # User messages remain user role
637	            conv["conversations"].append(
638	                {
639	                    "role": "user",
640	                    "content": message,
641	                }
642	            )
643	        elif source == "agent":
644	            # Agent messages become assistant role
645	            # Format: <think>reasoning_content</think> + message + tool_calls JSON
646	            content_parts = []
647	
648	            # Prepend reasoning_content wrapped in <think></think> tags if present
649	            reasoning_content = step.get("reasoning_content")
650	            if reasoning_content:
651	                content_parts.append(f"<think>{reasoning_content}</think>")
652	
653	            # Add the main message content
654	            if message:
655	                # Fix orphaned </think> tags: when the generation prompt includes
656	                # <think> but vLLM only returns generated tokens, the opening tag
657	                # is missing.  Detect this pattern and prepend <think> to restore
658	                # proper formatting.
659	                if "</think>" in message and "<think>" not in message:
660	                    message = "<think>" + message
661	                content_parts.append(message)
662	
663	            # Append tool_calls in the specified format if present
664	            # Format: <tool_call>\n{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}\n</tool_call>
665	            tool_calls = step.get("tool_calls")
666	            if tool_calls:
667	                for tool_call in tool_calls:
668	                    tool_call_obj = {
669	                        "name": tool_call.get("function_name"),
670	                        "arguments": tool_call.get("arguments", {}),
671	                    }
672	                    tool_call_json = json.dumps(tool_call_obj, ensure_ascii=False)
673	                    content_parts.append(f"<tool_call>\n{tool_call_json}\n</tool_call>")
674	
675	            assistant_content = "\n".join(content_parts) if content_parts else ""
676	
677	            conv["conversations"].append(
678	                {
679	                    "role": "assistant",
680	                    "content": assistant_content,
681	                }
682	            )
683	
684	            # Add observation as user message, UNLESS this is the last agent step in the episode
685	            # (the last agent step's observation belongs to the next episode)
686	            is_last_agent_step = i == agent_steps[-1]
687	            if not is_last_agent_step:
688	                observation = step.get("observation")
689	                if observation and isinstance(observation, dict):
690	                    results = observation.get("results", [])
691	                    if results:
692	                        # Combine all observation results into a single user message
693	                        observation_contents = []
694	                        for result in results:
695	                            if isinstance(result, dict) and "content" in result:
696	                                # Use normalize_message_content to handle both string
697	                                # and list content formats
698	                                observation_contents.append(
699	                                    normalize_message_content(result["content"])
700	                                )
701	
702	                        if observation_contents:
703	                            observation_text = "\n".join(observation_contents)
704	                            conv["conversations"].append(
705	                                {
706	                                    "role": "user",
707	                                    "content": observation_text,
708	                                }
709	                            )
710	
711	    return conv

398	def _extract_trial_result_value(trial_dir: Path, trial_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
399	    """Return exception type or reward bucket for a given trial.
400	
401	    Checks two sources in order:
402	    1. Job-level result.json (aggregate stats from eval orchestrator)
403	    2. Per-trial result.json (individual trial result with verifier_result)
404	
405	    The job-level file exists for eval/datagen jobs but NOT for RL training jobs,
406	    where each trial has its own result.json with verifier_result.rewards.
407	    """
408	    # 1. Try job-level aggregate stats (eval orchestrator)
409	    result_data = _load_job_result_data(trial_dir)
410	    if result_data:
411	        stats = result_data.get("stats")
412	        if isinstance(stats, dict):
413	            evals = stats.get("evals")
414	            if isinstance(evals, dict):
415	                for eval_data in evals.values():
416	                    if not isinstance(eval_data, dict):
417	                        continue
418	
419	                    exception_stats = eval_data.get("exception_stats")
420	                    if isinstance(exception_stats, dict):
421	                        for exc_name, entries in exception_stats.items():
422	                            if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
423	                                return exc_name
424	
425	                    reward_stats = eval_data.get("reward_stats")
426	                    if isinstance(reward_stats, dict):
427	                        reward_map = reward_stats.get("reward")
428	                        if isinstance(reward_map, dict):
429	                            for reward_value, entries in reward_map.items():
430	                                if isinstance(entries, list) and trial_name in entries:
431	                                    result_value = _coerce_reward_value(reward_value)
432	                                    return (
433	                                        result_value
434	                                        if isinstance(result_value, str)
435	                                        else str(result_value)
436	                                    )
437	
438	    # 2. Fallback: read per-trial result.json directly (RL training jobs)
439	    trial_data = _load_result_data(trial_dir)
440	    if isinstance(trial_data, dict):
441	        # Check for exception first
442	        exc_info = trial_data.get("exception_info")
443	        if isinstance(exc_info, dict):
444	            exc_type = exc_info.get("exception_type")
445	            if exc_type:
446	                return str(exc_type)
447	
448	        # Extract reward from verifier_result
449	        vr = trial_data.get("verifier_result")
450	        if isinstance(vr, dict):
451	            rewards = vr.get("rewards")
452	            if isinstance(rewards, dict):
453	                reward = rewards.get("reward")
454	                if reward is not None:
455	                    return str(_coerce_reward_value(reward))
456	
457	    return None
458

468	def extract_conversations_from_trajectory(
469	    trajectory_file: Path,
470	    run_metadata: dict[str, Any],
471	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
472	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
473	    """Extract all episode conversations from a trajectory file.
474	
475	    Reads the trajectory once and generates one conversation per episode.
476	    Episodes are determined by agent steps - each agent step marks the end of an episode.
477	
478	    Note: Steps marked with is_copied_context=True are excluded from training data
479	    as they represent interactions already present in previous trajectories.
480	
481	    Args:
482	        trajectory_file: Path to the trajectory.json file
483	        run_metadata: Run metadata dictionary
484	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
485	            system message as ``<tools>...</tools>`` tags (default: True)
486	
487	    Returns:
488	        List of conversation dicts, one per episode
489	
490	    Raises:
491	        MultimodalExportError: If the trajectory contains multimodal content (images).
492	            Text-only export does not support multimodal trajectories to prevent
493	            silent data loss.
494	    """
495	    try:
496	        trajectory_data = json.loads(trajectory_file.read_text())
497	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
498	        print(f"[traces] Skipping trajectory {trajectory_file}: invalid JSON ({e})")
499	        return []
500	
501	    # FAIL FAST: Check for multimodal content
502	    if _trajectory_has_multimodal_content(trajectory_data):
503	        raise MultimodalExportError(
504	            f"Trajectory '{trajectory_file}' contains multimodal content (images). "
505	            f"Text-only export is not supported for multimodal trajectories. "
506	            f"Use a multimodal training pipeline or filter out multimodal trajectories."
507	        )
508	
509	    steps = trajectory_data.get("steps", [])
510	
511	    # Use agent name from trajectory if available (for subagent trajectories),
512	    # otherwise fall back to run_metadata agent name
513	    agent_info = trajectory_data.get("agent", {})
514	    trajectory_agent_name = agent_info.get("name") or run_metadata["agent_name"]
515	    trajectory_model_name = agent_info.get("model_name") or run_metadata["model_name"]
516	
517	    # Extract tool definitions if available
518	    tool_definitions = agent_info.get("tool_definitions")
519	
520	    # Create a modified run_metadata for this specific trajectory
521	    trajectory_run_metadata = {
522	        **run_metadata,
523	        "agent_name": trajectory_agent_name,
524	        "model_name": trajectory_model_name,
525	        "tool_definitions": tool_definitions,
526	    }
527	
528	    # Find all agent steps (each marks the end of an episode)
529	    # Exclude steps marked as copied context
530	    agent_step_indices = []
531	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
532	        if step.get("source") == "agent":
533	            # Skip steps marked as copied context (e.g., handoff steps)
534	            if step.get("is_copied_context"):
535	                continue
536	            agent_step_indices.append(i)
537	
538	    if not agent_step_indices:
539	        return []
540	
541	    # Generate one conversation per episode
542	    conversations = []
543	    for episode_num, agent_step_idx in enumerate(agent_step_indices):
544	        conv = _extract_single_episode_conversation(
545	            steps[
546	                : agent_step_idx + 1
547	            ],  # Include all steps up to and including this agent step
548	            episode_num,
549	            trajectory_run_metadata,
550	            embed_tools_in_conversation,
551	        )
552	        if conv and conv.get("conversations"):
553	            conversations.append(conv)
554	
555	    return conversations
556

558	def _extract_single_episode_conversation(
559	    steps: list[dict[str, Any]],
560	    episode_num: int,
561	    run_metadata: dict[str, Any],
562	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
563	) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
564	    """Extract conversation for a single episode from trajectory steps.
565	
566	    Episodes end with the assistant's response. Observations from each agent step
567	    are added as user messages before the next agent turn, except for the last
568	    agent step in the episode (whose observation belongs to the next episode).
569	
570	    Steps marked with is_copied_context=True are included in the conversation
571	    but don't trigger new episode boundaries.
572	
573	    Args:
574	        steps: List of trajectory steps for this episode
575	        episode_num: Episode number (0-indexed)
576	        run_metadata: Run metadata dictionary
577	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
578	            system message
579	
580	    Returns:
581	        Conversation dict for this episode
582	    """
583	    conv: dict[str, Any] = {
584	        "conversations": [],
585	        "agent": run_metadata["agent_name"],
586	        "model": run_metadata["model_name"],
587	        "model_provider": run_metadata["model_provider"],
588	        "date": run_metadata["start_time"],
589	        "task": None,  # to be filled by caller
590	        "episode": f"episode-{episode_num}",
591	        "run_id": run_metadata["run_id"],
592	        "trial_name": None,  # to be filled by caller
593	    }
594	
595	    # Add tool definitions if available
596	    if run_metadata.get("tool_definitions"):
597	        conv["tool_definitions"] = run_metadata["tool_definitions"]
598	
599	    # Track agent steps to know when to add observations
600	    # Note: We use ALL steps (including copied context) for building the conversation
601	    agent_steps = []
602	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
603	        if step.get("source") == "agent":
604	            agent_steps.append(i)
605	
606	    # Track if we've added tool definitions yet (should be added to first system message)
607	    tool_definitions_added = False
608	
609	    for i, step in enumerate(steps):
610	        source = step.get("source")
611	        message = step.get("message", "")
612	
613	        if source == "system":
614	            # System messages become user role (task instruction from user)
615	            # Add tool definitions to the first system message if available
616	            content = message
617	            if (
618	                embed_tools_in_conversation
619	                and not tool_definitions_added
620	                and run_metadata.get("tool_definitions")
621	            ):
622	                # Format tool definitions as <tools>...</tools>
623	                tools_json = json.dumps(
624	                    run_metadata["tool_definitions"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2
625	                )
626	                content = f"<tools>\n{tools_json}\n</tools>\n\n{message}"
627	                tool_definitions_added = True
628	
629	            conv["conversations"].append(
630	                {
631	                    "role": "user",
632	                    "content": content,
633	                }
634	            )
635	        elif source == "user":
636	            # User messages remain user role
637	            conv["conversations"].append(
638	                {
639	                    "role": "user",
640	                    "content": message,
641	                }
642	            )
643	        elif source == "agent":
644	            # Agent messages become assistant role
645	            # Format: <think>reasoning_content</think> + message + tool_calls JSON
646	            content_parts = []
647	
648	            # Prepend reasoning_content wrapped in <think></think> tags if present
649	            reasoning_content = step.get("reasoning_content")
650	            if reasoning_content:
651	                content_parts.append(f"<think>{reasoning_content}</think>")
652	
653	            # Add the main message content
654	            if message:
655	                # Fix orphaned </think> tags: when the generation prompt includes
656	                # <think> but vLLM only returns generated tokens, the opening tag
657	                # is missing.  Detect this pattern and prepend <think> to restore
658	                # proper formatting.
659	                if "</think>" in message and "<think>" not in message:
660	                    message = "<think>" + message
661	                content_parts.append(message)
662	
663	            # Append tool_calls in the specified format if present
664	            # Format: <tool_call>\n{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}\n</tool_call>
665	            tool_calls = step.get("tool_calls")
666	            if tool_calls:
667	                for tool_call in tool_calls:
668	                    tool_call_obj = {
669	                        "name": tool_call.get("function_name"),
670	                        "arguments": tool_call.get("arguments", {}),
671	                    }
672	                    tool_call_json = json.dumps(tool_call_obj, ensure_ascii=False)
673	                    content_parts.append(f"<tool_call>\n{tool_call_json}\n</tool_call>")
674	
675	            assistant_content = "\n".join(content_parts) if content_parts else ""
676	
677	            conv["conversations"].append(
678	                {
679	                    "role": "assistant",
680	                    "content": assistant_content,
681	                }
682	            )
683	
684	            # Add observation as user message, UNLESS this is the last agent step in the episode
685	            # (the last agent step's observation belongs to the next episode)
686	            is_last_agent_step = i == agent_steps[-1]
687	            if not is_last_agent_step:
688	                observation = step.get("observation")
689	                if observation and isinstance(observation, dict):
690	                    results = observation.get("results", [])
691	                    if results:
692	                        # Combine all observation results into a single user message
693	                        observation_contents = []
694	                        for result in results:
695	                            if isinstance(result, dict) and "content" in result:
696	                                # Use normalize_message_content to handle both string
697	                                # and list content formats
698	                                observation_contents.append(
699	                                    normalize_message_content(result["content"])
700	                                )
701	
702	                        if observation_contents:
703	                            observation_text = "\n".join(observation_contents)
704	                            conv["conversations"].append(
705	                                {
706	                                    "role": "user",
707	                                    "content": observation_text,
708	                                }
709	                            )
710	
711	    return conv

714	def _extract_subagent_refs_from_trajectory(
715	    trajectory_file: Path,
716	) -> list[str]:
717	    """Extract subagent trajectory references from a trajectory file.
718	
719	    Returns:
720	        List of trajectory filenames referenced in the trajectory (e.g., ["trajectory.summarization-1-summary.json"])
721	    """

725	        return []
726	
727	    refs = []
728	    steps = trajectory_data.get("steps", [])

730	    for step in steps:
731	        observation = step.get("observation", {})

734

736	        for result in results:
737	            if not isinstance(result, dict):

739

746	    return refs

749	def collect_conversations_from_trial(
750	    trial_dir: Path,
751	    run_meta: dict[str, Any],
752	    episodes: str = "all",
753	    verbose: bool = False,
754	    include_instruction: bool = False,
755	    include_verifier_output: bool = False,
756	    embed_tools_in_conversation: bool = True,
757	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
758	    """Collect conversation traces from a trial.
759	
760	    Supports:
761	    - Single trajectory files
762	    - Continuation trajectories (when linear_history mode is enabled)
763	
764	    Note: This function only collects traces from the main agent trajectory
765	    and its continuations. For subagent traces, use collect_subagent_traces().
766	
767	    Args:
768	        trial_dir: Path to trial directory
769	        run_meta: Run metadata dictionary
770	        episodes: "all" to collect all episodes, or "last" to collect only the last completed episode
771	        verbose: Whether to print verbose output
772	        include_instruction: Include instruction text metadata when available
773	        include_verifier_output: Include verifier stdout/stderr metadata when available
774	        embed_tools_in_conversation: Whether to embed tool definitions in the first
775	            system message (default: True)
776	
777	    Returns:
778	        List of conversation dicts
779	    """
780	    task_name = run_meta["task_name"]
781	    trial_name = run_meta["trial_name"]
782	    result_value = _extract_trial_result_value(trial_dir, trial_name)
783	    instruction_text = (
784	        _extract_instruction(trial_dir, run_meta["agent_name"])
785	        if include_instruction
786	        else None
787	    )
788	    verifier_output = (
789	        _read_verifier_output(trial_dir) if include_verifier_output else None
790	    )
791	
792	    agent_dir = trial_dir / "agent"
793	
794	    # Build trajectory processing order
795	    # Only include main trajectory and continuation trajectories
796	    # Subagent trajectories should be exported separately
797	    trajectory_order = []
798	
799	    # Start with main trajectory
800	    main_traj = agent_dir / "trajectory.json"
801	    if not main_traj.exists():
802	        if verbose:
803	            print(f"[traces] Trial {trial_dir.name}: no trajectory.json found")
804	        return []
805	
806	    trajectory_order.append(main_traj)
807	
808	    # Follow continuation chain using continued_trajectory_ref from each trajectory
809	    # (Subagent trajectories are NOT added here - they go to separate trace files)
810	    current_traj_path = main_traj
811	    while True:
812	        try:
813	            trajectory_data = json.loads(current_traj_path.read_text())
814	        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
815	            break
816	
817	        # Check if this trajectory has a continuation
818	        continued_ref = trajectory_data.get("continued_trajectory_ref")
819	        if not continued_ref:
820	            break
821	
822	        # Resolve the continuation path relative to the agent directory
823	        next_traj_path = agent_dir / continued_ref
824	        if not next_traj_path.exists():
825	            if verbose:
826	                print(
827	                    f"[traces] Warning: continued_trajectory_ref '{continued_ref}' in {current_traj_path.name} points to non-existent file"
828	                )
829	            break
830	
831	        trajectory_order.append(next_traj_path)
832	        current_traj_path = next_traj_path
833	
834	    # Extract conversations from all trajectory files in order
835	    all_conversations = []
836	    episode_offset = 0
837	
838	    for traj_file in trajectory_order:
839	        conversations = extract_conversations_from_trajectory(
840	            traj_file, run_meta, embed_tools_in_conversation
841	        )
842	
843	        # Adjust episode numbers to be globally unique across all trajectory files
844	        for conv in conversations:
845	            episode_num = int(conv["episode"].split("-")[1])
846	            conv["episode"] = f"episode-{episode_offset + episode_num}"
847	
848	        all_conversations.extend(conversations)
849	        episode_offset += len(conversations)
850	
851	    if not all_conversations:
852	        if verbose:
853	            print(
854	                f"[traces] Trial {trial_dir.name}: no conversations found in trajectories"
855	            )
856	        return []
857	
858	    # Handle "last" episode filter
859	    if episodes == "last":
860	        all_conversations = [all_conversations[-1]]
861	        if verbose:
862	            print(
863	                f"[traces] Trial {trial_dir.name}: selected last episode {all_conversations[0]['episode']}"
864	            )
865	
866	    # Fill in task and trial_name for all conversations
867	    for conv in all_conversations:
868	        conv["task"] = task_name
869	        conv["trial_name"] = trial_name
870	        conv["result"] = result_value
871	        if include_instruction:
872	            conv["instruction"] = instruction_text
873	        if include_verifier_output:
874	            conv["verifier_output"] = verifier_output
875	
876	    if verbose:
877	        traj_count = len(trajectory_order)
878	        traj_suffix = f" ({traj_count} trajectory files)" if traj_count > 1 else ""
879	        print(
880	            f"[traces] Collected {len(all_conversations)} rows from trial {trial_dir.name}{traj_suffix}"
881	        )
882	
883	    return all_conversations
